_sheet_scope: このシートはセグメントブリッジに加え、(a) FY2026/1 特別損失の正常化ブリッジ、(b) 防衛事業の前提セル(単価×台数)、(c) 資金繰りと希薄化の分析 の3表を持つ。シート名 'Segment Bridge' は汎用スクリプト add_segment_bridge.py の固定値であり変更していない(銘柄別スクリプトを作らない運用のため)。
title: Segment Bridge, Loss Normalisation, Defence Assumptions and Dilution - Terra Drone (278A)
intro: All figures JPY mn. Two reportable segments: Drone Solutions (survey and inspection services) and UTM (unmanned traffic management, built around the Unifly equity-method holding).

The point of the first table: BOTH segments were loss-making and getting worse before the August 2026 defence contract. Drone Solutions went from a JPY194mn to a JPY435mn segment loss; UTM from JPY433mn to JPY709mn on almost flat revenue of about JPY620mn. UTM also carries a further JPY439mn of equity-method losses below the operating line, so it bleeds twice.

Tables 5 to 7 hold the analysis the standard eight sheets have no place for: what the FY1/26 special losses do and do not change, the explicit unit-price x volume assumptions behind the defence revenue in the Base and Upside scenarios, and how much equity has to be issued to fund the plan.
Tables 5 and 7 are live formulas off 'DCF Model' and follow the scenario selector in 'DCF Model'!C27. Table 6 is a set of blue input cells: they are estimates, not disclosure.

The unit price of JPY5.0mn is the single most important unmodelled variable: at JPY2.0mn per unit the defence revenue in both scenarios falls to 40% of the amounts above, and the Upside case loses roughly half its terminal operating profit. extra_tables.note: The asymmetry is the finding. At today's price the whole Base plan is funded for about 3% dilution - the theme price itself solves the funding problem. If the theme deflates towards the DCF or Comps values, the SAME cash requirement costs 40-60% of the company. Dilution risk here is a function of the share price, and it bites hardest exactly when the equity story has already failed. Switch 'DCF Model'!C27 to Downside 1 and the 'funding required as a multiple of the DCF Exit equity value' row goes above 10x: the plan is not financeable at that valuation at all, which is itself the answer. Read that ratio by scenario: Upside 0.11x, Management 0.31x, Base 0.49x, Downside 1 10.25x (not financeable), Downside 2 negative (there is no positive modelled equity value to fund against). Rows that would divide by a zero or negative modelled value show n/a rather than a spurious number. Every per-share figure on 'Executive Summary' and 'DCF Model' is PRE-dilution and therefore flattering.

notes: Segment profit is the disclosed segment operating profit; the adjustment row carries corporate costs and eliminations and is close to zero in both years, so the bridge closes cleanly.
Segment operating margin: Drone Solutions -5.1% (FY1/25) -> -10.4% (FY1/26); UTM -69.0% -> -114.4%. Consolidated -14.1% -> -23.9%.
Segment D&A is only disclosed for FY1/26, so the D&A bridge has one usable column. The FY1/26 segment total (414 + 113 = 527) ties to consolidated D&A of 527.3.
Consolidated EBITDA is negative in both years (-297.1 and -616.5). This is why the model uses EV/Sales rather than EV/EBITDA as the primary multiple.

No segment data has been published for FY1/27 Q1 or for the defence contract. The mid-September 2026 second-quarter results are the first chance to see whether defence revenue lands in Drone Solutions or in a new segment, and at what margin.
This sheet is informational except where noted: tables 5 and 7 contain live references INTO 'DCF Model' and 'Comps Analysis', but no cell on 'DCF Model' references this sheet.
open_items: 防衛事業の単価5.0百万円/台と台数はすべて推定。契約金額・数量・納期はいずれも未開示
2026/8/25の防衛装備庁「迎撃ドローン早期取得プログラム」量産調達契約について、公表されているのは契約締結の事実のみ。単価はUpsideで年200〜260億円規模(=年数百億)、Baseで年50〜63億円規模(=年数十億)というプロンプトのシナリオ定義を満たすよう逆算的に置いた。単価が半分なら両シナリオの防衛売上は半減し、Upsideのターミナル営業利益は約半分になる。
希薄化分析の前提: 最低運転現金1,000百万、発行価格は各参照値の80%、既存新株予約権490,400株

最低現金1,000は現行の四半期販管費(884)約1期分。発行価格80%はグロース市場の公募・第三者割当のディスカウント慣行(ディスカウント率は通常3〜10%だが、テーマ剥落局面での資金調達を想定し保守的に20%)。新株予約権490,400株は『提出日現在の潜在株式1,142,200株』から、現行株数10,397,100と提出日株数9,745,300の差651,800が行使によるものと仮定して差し引いた残高であり、確認できていない。
